entries.german: Karl IV. macht auf seine Lebenszeit in Erinnerung der Dienste des sel. Peter von Rosenberg zugunsten König Johanns von Böhmen den Jodok von Rosenberg und dessen Brüder, Peters Söhne, zu Sammlern der allgemeinen berna in provinciis seu districtiibus Multaviensi, Chinowiensi, Bechinensi, Dudlebensi, Netolicensi, Wolynensi, Prachinensi et Woznensi in Böhmen.
entries.english: Charles IV, in remembrance of the services of the late Peter von Rosenberg in favor of King John of Bohemia, appoints Jodok von Rosenberg and his brothers, sons of Peter, as collectors of the general berna (a type of tax) for their lifetime in the provinces or districts of Mulda, Kina, Bechin, Dudleitz, Netolitz, Wolyn, Prachin, and Wozn in Bohemia.

entries.english: During his lifetime, in remembrance of the services of the late Peter von Rosenberg, appoints Jodok von Rosenberg and his brothers, sons of Peter, as collectors of the general tithe (berna) in the provinces or districts of Mulhouse (Multaviensi), Kutná Hora (Chinowiensi), Béchyň (Bechinensi), Dudlitz (Dudlebensi), Netolice (Netolicensi), Volyně (Wolynensi), Prachatice (Prachinensi) and Votice (Woznensi). Cod. Mor. 7,657 extr. F. R. Austr. II. 37,399 n. 1 extr.
